refined_nucleus: A high-strength, low-modulus polymer layer with a high thermal conductivity material is embedded between the transducer array elements and the imaging electronics to absorb and distribute mechanical stress, while also mitigating thermal stress through a novel thermal-mechanical coupling mechanism, which is validated by experimental data or simulations demonstrating the effectiveness of the thermal-mechanical coupling mechanism.
new_relationship: The relationship between thermal conductivity and mechanical stress is established through a novel thermal-mechanical coupling mechanism, which is validated by experimental data or simulations.
new_configuration: The transducer array element, polymer layer, and imaging electronics module are arranged in a stacked configuration with an additional thermal interface material (TIM) between the polymer layer and the imaging electronics module.
new_control_rule: The control logic is modified to include a thermal stress monitoring step, which activates the polymer layer if thermal stress exceeds a threshold value.
refined_structure: The device consists of a transducer array element, a polymer layer, a thermal interface material, and an imaging electronics module, arranged in a stacked configuration.
refined_causal_chain: step1: Measure mechanical stress on the transducer array element
step2: Measure thermal stress on the polymer layer
step3: Compare measured stress to threshold value
step4: Activate polymer layer if stress exceeds threshold
step5: Monitor thermal interface material for degradation
step6: Adjust thermal interface material if degradation is detected
